screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-ntfy-alerts
screenshots.alt: The ntfy alerts section of Settings: the send ntfy alerts switch explained as notifying your phone when a session waits for you, and the topic field explained as needing a hard-to-guess name.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-pin-to-top
screenshots.alt: A session's menu with pin to top highlighted, explained as keeping the session above the others in every window using the helm.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-quick-launch
screenshots.alt: The Templates list with the lightning bolt beside a template highlighted, explained as marking the template Cmd+P or Ctrl+Shift+P starts.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-number-keys
screenshots.alt: A template's number key menu open in Templates, listing the keys it can take, explained as starting the template with Cmd or Ctrl+Shift and that number.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-custom-permissions
screenshots.alt: The session launcher's permissions with custom chosen and permission flags typed, explained as passed to the agent instead of Farhelm's flags; guarded explained as the new default.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-file-hover
screenshots.alt: The hover over a file path in a terminal, with a file icon, the host and full path, and the size, explained, along with Cmd-click in the desktop app.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-claude-trust
screenshots.alt: The switch in Settings that answers Claude's trust question for new managed checkouts, explained as off by default, with its caveats below it.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-session-confirmations
screenshots.alt: The skip session confirmations switch in Settings, explained as letting delete, replace, restart and closing a shell tab act on the first click.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-welcome
screenshots.alt: The welcome card, with links to Get started and to send feedback, explained as shown on first open and kept in the ? menu.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-help-menu
screenshots.alt: The ? menu with release notes pointed out, explained as opening these release notes in your browser.

screenshots.name: release-notes/v0-29-0-permission-switch
screenshots.alt: The session launcher after switching from Claude in guarded to Pi: a warning that the permission changed to YOLO, with Undo pointed out.
